purpose: Per-fact evidence for pack.json (CMP-028), moved from the source table of the former README.md. Status: tested (evidenceStatus: unverified, testOnly: false, certification level tested awaiting named human and counsel review per ADR-0031 and ADR-0034). Owner: partner (sayegh9). Primary research source: docs/compliance/egypt-research.md (external URLs accessed 2026-11-18), docs/compliance/country-matrix.md and docs/architecture/calendars-and-locale.md. Anything without a verified primary source is UNVERIFIED. Labels: VERIFIED-OFFICIAL, SECONDARY (treat as UNVERIFIED), UNVERIFIED, PLATFORM-DEFAULT (a platform choice, not a statutory claim); recordedStatus keeps the former README status text verbatim. Sources that egypt-research.md marks as snippets or PRIMARY-SNIPPET (page not read in full) carry read: false and no access date. The pack contains no tax, e-invoicing or payroll maths (principle 3, ADR-0031). NOT legal advice.

facts.claim: Identity: countryCode EG, packId eg, componentId country.eg. Phase-1 operating market.
Chart of accounts: coaTemplate finance.coa_eg (eg_unified_coa_unverified). Official unified chart of accounts lead.

VAT: vatSupported true, taxCodesRef eg.tax_codes_unverified (no inline rates). Standard VAT 14%; 5% for production machinery/equipment (Law 149/2026 reported); separate schedule tax; Law 157/2025 moved construction from 5% schedule tax to 14% VAT; registration threshold EGP 500,000; reverse charge on non-resident services.

facts.claim: VAT filing: filingPeriods [monthly]. Monthly electronic VAT returns and payment due by the end of the following month.

Rounding: roundingRule half_away_from_zero. Platform Commercial Rounding rule (ADR-0033); Egypt statutory VAT rounding unconfirmed; ETA e-invoicing spec decimal precision not yet researched (explicit research gap).
facts.recordedStatus: UNVERIFIED (Egypt VAT rounding & ETA decimal precision not researched)

facts.claim: Tax and CR number patterns: vatNumberPattern, crNumberPattern (^[0-9A-Za-z/-]{1,64}$). Entity and commercial register formats not yet researched (E9).

E-invoicing authority and API: authority Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA). ETA runs eInvoicing and eReceipt APIs; taxpayer registers ERP/POS system; CAdES-BES Base64 signature over SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 document; PreProd and Prod environments exist.

E-invoicing mandate and rollout: required true, mode eg_e_invoice, componentId compliance.eta_eg. Ministerial Decision 188 of 2020; ETA home page states all taxpayers from 2022-12-15 / customs 2023-04-01; phased rollout and 2026 decree conflict; HSM/USB token requirement reported by vendors only.

facts.claim: Archive retention: archiveRetentionYears 5. Tax records kept 5 years from return date (6 years in evasion cases); Law 7/2025 effect unchecked.
Timezone and DST: timezone Africa/Cairo. Stored UTC, displayed in Africa/Cairo via IANA tz database (no fixed offset); Egypt reintroduced daylight saving time in 2023 (monitor tzdata updates).

Calendar: primary gregorian, secondaryDisplay none. Gregorian used in practice for commerce and tax; Hijri used for religious dates/holidays (with Egypt-specific moon-sighting announcements); Coptic not planned for v1.

Week and weekend: startDay sun, weekendDays [fri, sat], workDays [sun, mon, tue, wed, thu], hours 09:00-17:00. Default Fri-Sat weekend; overridable per company; work-week and hours not yet officially researched.

Fiscal year: type gregorian, startMonth 1, startDay 1 (allowedFiscalYearTypes [gregorian], overridable). Gregorian fiscal year; commercial Jan 1 default (companies using July 1 can override, UNVERIFIED).
Holidays: calendarRef eg.holidays@0.1.0, announcedDates []. Public holidays not yet researched.
Number system and formats: numberSystem western, decimalSeparator ".", thousandsSeparator ",". Western vs Eastern Arabic digits per-company setting; digit style not researched (E6).
Currency: currency EGP, currencyDecimals 2. EGP legal currency (general knowledge, unsourced in research); FX rules not researched (E7).

Document and print languages: eInvoicing.mandatoryDocumentLanguages [ar], printFormats.mandatoryLanguages [ar]. Arabic requirement on invoices and contracts not researched (E6; open counsel question, research Q11: whether Arabic is required on invoices/contracts and whether foreign-currency invoices are allowed).

Payroll and social insurance: wpsEnabled false, wpsFormatRef null, socialInsuranceRef null, eosbRuleRef null. Out of v1 scope (Later in matrix E4). Research notes Law 148/2019 (11% employee / 18.75% employer, EGP 2,700-16,700 floor/ceiling from Jan 2026), Law 7/2024 income tax (EGP 20,000 exemption, 0-27.5% bands), Law 14/2025 labour law (in force 2025-09-01); none active in v1.

Date display formats: gregorianDateFormat YYYY-MM-DD, hijriDateFormat iYYYY-iMM-iDD. The former README source table had no row for these values and recorded no source; this entry was added in the evidence.json conversion so every leaf has an entry. No value changed.

Print templates and legal layout: three templates (tax_invoice, credit_note, debit_note) owned by compliance.eta_eg, which does not exist yet (review of #256, item 4); legalLayoutPrecedence true is fixed by the pack schema (const: true), not an Egypt fact. The former README source table had no row for these values and recorded no source; this entry was added in the evidence.json conversion. No value changed.
